principle: Every target enzyme-reaction edge is absent from clean2023. Surfaces differ only in whether the query entity was previously known or whether evaluation is conditioned on Broad candidate retrieval; no target relation is made visible.

query_seen_relation_unseen.interpretation: Database-extension setting: the query enzyme/reaction has at least one train-known relation, while every evaluated target relation is new.

broad_top1000_conditional_reranking.interpretation: Stage-specific reranking surface: exact relation remains unseen; evaluate only queries for which Broad retrieved at least one correct target in Top1000. This measures ranking quality conditional on candidate recall and must not be presented as end-to-end coverage.

e2r.note: E2R expert reranking is not candidate-set preserving, so final Hit@1000 can fall below 1 even on the Broad-covered subset.

both_entities_seen_relation_unseen.recommendation: Too small to use as a headline benchmark; retain only as an optional diagnostic.
